title: ethereum/go-ethereum v1.5.7: Peacher (v1.5.7)
summary:

See the 1.5.7 milestone for more details.

title: ethereum/go-ethereum v1.5.6: Peach (v1.5.6)
summary:
Geth 1.5.6 - Peach (:peach:) is a refactor and clean up (plumping) release.
This release also improves the EVMs call stack (#3378) and improves the overal EVM performance by 40% and is a pre-patch for the next 64bit gas counting PR. It will also allow for unmetered EVM calls for non-consensus critic
